ticket.title: ADR 0009 amends worktree resolution; ADR 0010 records the ticket record contract
ticket.description: ADR 0009 amends 0001: source state (ticket files, plans) is worktree-local and tracked, so a change rides the branch that made it and merges per file; derived state (index, rollup, leases, telemetry) resolves through the git common dir and is never tracked. ADR 0001 chose common-dir resolution to prevent a split-brain append-only log, a reason that per-ticket files remove. ADR 0010 records the ticket record shape (ticket, ordered events, external mapping), the invariants (one file per ticket, owner by scope.repo, a prefix is not an owner, edges carry a locator, a duplicate uuid is corruption) and the integration seam: an external field plus a written adapter contract, explicitly not an implementation.
acceptance_criteria: both ADRs accepted; ADR 0001 carries a superseded-in-part note pointing at 0009; the adapter contract states what is deliberately out of scope
